name: Off-Highway Vehicle
description: A motorized vehicle designed for cross-country travel on natural terrain, power motor cycles and related two-wheel vehicles included; an electric dirt bike like a Sur-Ron or Talaria is one.

restrictions.rule: Designed for cross-country travel on land, water, snow, ice, marsh or other natural terrain; no limit on motor power or speed
restrictions.citation: Off-highway Vehicle Act, R.S.P.E.I. 1988, c. O-3, s. 1(g)

restrictions.rule: Registered with the Registrar, with a licence plate displayed; a restricted registration covers only land the owner or operator owns, leases or lives on
restrictions.citation: Off-highway Vehicle Act, R.S.P.E.I. 1988, c. O-3, ss. 2 and 8; Off-Highway Vehicle Act Regulations, P.E.I. Reg. EC96/88, s. 2

restrictions.rule: The operator and any passenger must wear an approved helmet, wrap-around goggles, gloves, footwear and clothing covering the whole body
restrictions.citation: Off-Highway Vehicle Act Regulations, P.E.I. Reg. EC96/88, s. 6

restrictions.rule: A dirt bike rider must be 14 or older and have passed an approved off-highway vehicle safety course; a younger one only for a competition, supervised by an adult
restrictions.citation: Off-Highway Vehicle Act Regulations, P.E.I. Reg. EC96/88, ss. 12.1 and 12.2

restrictions.rule: Its engine may not exceed the manufacturer's recommendation for the rider's age and weight
restrictions.citation: Off-Highway Vehicle Act Regulations, P.E.I. Reg. EC96/88, s. 6.1

restrictions.rule: Never on any part of a highway except to cross it at right angles, after stopping, unloading passengers and yielding, or where regulations allow
restrictions.citation: Off-highway Vehicle Act, R.S.P.E.I. 1988, c. O-3, s. 12

restrictions.rule: Not on the Confederation Trail except at a designated crossing with a snowmobile club permit
restrictions.citation: Off-highway Vehicle Act, R.S.P.E.I. 1988, c. O-3, s. 1.2
